content.short: Origin Thread is the only brand that uses NFTs to connect men with how their clothes have been made.
content.description: Where do your clothes come from? Who made them? How much were they paid? The fashion industry suffers from a lack of transparency. Customers are disconnected with how their clothes are made. This means that destructive sourcing practices are common place. We're using NFTs as a permenant record of truth of our clothes sourcing information. Every garment that we sell comes with a unique NFT proving its authenticity and scarcity as well as linking to fully transparent sourcing information. Each NFT also contains a video of the manufacturing process of each shirt.
content.meta: Find out about Origin Thread (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
